name: gamified3d-monorepo
description: UI/UX framework for 2.5D game-style interfaces on three.js: stage, grid, interaction, DOM anchors, motion and accessibility. Companion to gamifiedUI.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=gamified3d-demo
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=gamified3d-stage && npm run build --workspace=gamified3d-interaction
scripts.test: npm run check --workspace=gamified3d-stage && npm run check --workspace=gamified3d-interaction && node --test "packages/*/test/*.test.mjs" && npm run lint --workspace=gamified3d-demo
